phase: formula-pass (blind; stage A packet only; no claims seen)

identity.normalization: Canonical list already one entry per ingredient (upper-case source, matched case-insensitively); no split synonyms; no markers. Normalized one-based positions (ID-2) = packet positions.
identity.e3ProminenceCutoff: No Parfum/Fragrance declared; E3 preservative fallback = Sodium Benzoate @17 (Piroctone Olamine is not one of the seven E3 preservatives). Prominent = positions 1-16.

surfactants.c3Class: not a cleansing route and not a buffer (low-ethoxylate thickener)

formulaFacts.mildBase: Not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 (ether type) excludes MB.
formulaFacts.csa: Met via listed prominent routes (comfort: Panthenol@5, Bisabolol@6, Niacinamide@7; humectant/refatting: Panthenol@5, Glycerin@9, Glyceryl Oleate@13). MB not used (excluded).

wLine.plausibility: Panthenol@5: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 etc. listed before; (ii) positions 6-16 hold no cleansing surfactant (Laureth-2@14 is a low-ethoxylate thickener, not a C3 cleansing class and not a structurant for (ii)), no alkanolamide, no pearlizing wax. Plausible. (Piroctone Olamine@10 is also a class-b candidate but later.)
wLine.note: No payload_lipid; the W-line gates nothing here.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1 (settled core): defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 (ether type) with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3 and Coco-Glucoside@4 and no reinforcing strong anionic. Two buffers make the call robust; Laureth-2@14 is not a cleansing route (C3).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system (prominent cationic guar Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@8) plus light routes (weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate@13, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@15; humectants Panthenol@5, Glycerin@9). C2 not met: no early silicone, no prominent payload_lipid, no pearlizing/fatty route. Neighbor low: guar is the only substantive route in a cleansing-led base; high is unrealistic without C2/W-RICH.

weightPotential.wLine: Panthenol@5 (sub1_active); cap Sodium Benzoate@17; no payload_lipid to split.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: light - one cationic guar in mid-list plus weak refatters; no silicone, lipid, protein or film former.
weightPotential.persistence: low - light guar and glyceride refatters, no persistent silicone/lipid system.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families (cationic_polymer + weak_refatter, W2); guar at position 8 is reasonably prominent.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low anchor: a single light conditioning polymer plus weak refatters against a moderate reset; nothing persistent converges.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the only families are one guar polymer and late weak refatters (Glyceryl Oleate@13, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@15, after salt), with humectants as context; there is no silicone, payload lipid, protein or second cationic route, and the buffered SLES reset faces only these light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Guar dose/charge density unknown; could make residue noticeable (one band).
weightPotential.rationale: Low (moderate confidence): light deposition (guar@8 + weak refatters) against moderate C1 reset; W2 reasoning given.

careDirection.limitation: Blind verdict; relevant only if a lengths moisture/repair claim appears. Humectant cluster is modest; no protein cluster.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Recognized anti-dandruff active Piroctone Olamine@10 plus comfort routes suggest a scalp role, but focus needs a claim (3.2, R17.3).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: null (blind). Formula-compatible routes: scalp_active (piroctone; comfort routes), moisture (humectants + guar). Decision: provisional general pending claims.
focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): general until claims are revealed; scalp_active is the most plausible formula-compatible alternative.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): default regular. Formula pre-checks: dandruffSupport supported, so treatment fires if a qualifying E2 dandruff claim graded moderate/high appears (U3); cleansing not strong, so frequent is open under U2; alternating impossible.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): no positioning visible. CSA formula half met via listed prominent routes (comfort Panthenol@5, Bisabolol@6, Niacinamide@7; humectant Panthenol@5, Glycerin@9, Glyceryl Oleate@13). MB not met (SLES@2 prominent). No fragrance, cooling or essential-oil counter-signal. Becomes targeted only with a non-dandruff SC1 sensitive/dry-scalp unit (dandruff-unit symptoms do not count, SC1/E2a).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine@10. Formula-only; a dandruff target additionally needs a dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
